title: Quiz: Reading Documentation
description: Check your understanding of Reading Documentation.

questions.question: Which of these is the correct way to write a comment in Java?
questions.explanation: In Java, // marks a comment. Block comments use /* */.

questions.question: Where should you look FIRST for accurate syntax questions?
questions.explanation: Official docs are maintained and version-correct.

questions.question: True or False: Tutorials are always more reliable than official documentation.
questions.explanation: This statement is incorrect — review the lesson.

questions.question: Fill in the blank: look up the ___ before using an unfamiliar function
questions.explanation: Documentation describes exactly how functions behave.

questions.question: In Java, what is the safest way to predict what a program outputs?
options: Depends on the code — trace it line by line
questions.correctAnswer: Depends on the code — trace it line by line
questions.explanation: Read top to bottom, track variable values, and note every output statement.
